For years, people searched for a song usually called 'Everyone Knows That', or EKT. The search began on 7 October 2021, when a 17-second recording was uploaded to WatZatSong by a user known as carl92.

The mysterious recording quickly became one of the internet's most famous lostwave mysteries. People spent years trying to identify the song, its artist and where the recording came from.

The mystery was finally solved on 28 April 2024, when the song was identified as 'Ulterior Motives' by Christopher and Philip Booth. The recording was discovered in a film from 1986, finally revealing the source of the mysterious 17-second clip.

This version is a recreation, inspired by the mystery and the years spent searching for the song before its origin was discovered.
